node.title: Prize N=256 square-mass-18 cofactor-1028 exclusion
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(4,2,0) cofactor 1028 is impossible. The parent restricts it to V in {10,18}. Two independent complete normalized censuses cover 320292000 signed vectors, find no V=10 vector and 16 V=18 vectors, and prove that none of the latter has norm divisible by 257, contradicting 1028=4*257.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: dual 32-shard engines with distinct enumeration and autocorrelation implementations agree. The leading prize profile contracts from six to five live cofactors; no aggregate pair count is claimed.
